purpose: Targeted RQ1 case-grounding and intervention-proxy validation; not a new compression method or independent test set
selection_status: Post-hoc representative questions and diagnostic patches fixed before new validation outcomes

shortcuts.blank: 336x336 RGB filled with int(CLIP image_mean*255); normal vision encoder, not zero embeddings
shortcuts.question_only: Remove image placeholder and image tensor; preserve question/options; sequence length differs
shortcuts.permutation: Rotate only original option content; identity is byte-for-byte original question; map predictions back to original semantic choices

patch_selection: 16 seeded random indices first; then 8 highest positive archived I among non-basis photo/mixed patches not already selected; then 8 highest signed I within the low-E non-basis third, photo/mixed, excluding earlier picks (this last stratum can include negative effects). Diagnostic strata are post-hoc and summarized separately.

method_definitions.zero: Set one complete post-projector patch vector to zero, preserving sequence/mask/positions.
method_definitions.half: Replace one patch vector by 0.5 times its original value; a dose check along the zeroing direction.
method_definitions.neighbor_mean: Replace by the FP32 mean of original, unmodified cardinal neighbors inside the 24x24 grid (no wrapping), then cast to the original FP16 dtype. Photo/padding regions may mix at boundaries.
method_definitions.score: Signed I = original full-context reference mean teacher-forced log probability minus perturbed score; no EOS, no decoder pruning.
method_definitions.sham: Strength zero for each method returns a clone exactly equal to the full reference.
method_definitions.interpretation: Perturbations differ in size and may preserve information. They are diagnostics, not ground-truth importance or native ApET compression.
